items.title: Dial
items.name: Dial
items.summary: Give your AI agent a real phone number in 10 seconds
items.description: Your agent can deploy in seconds but cannot get a phone number. Dial fixes that - one API call and it gets a real one in about 10 seconds. It places and receives voice calls, sends and receives SMS in 200+ countries, and messages over iMessage. It can even read inbound verification codes, so phone-gated signups stop being a dead end. Works via REST API, CLI, MCP servers, and SDKs. Free credit on signup, no card.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Gal, founder of Dial.

Last year we were building an AI agent that needed to sign itself up for a service. It got all the way through the form, hit "we've texted you a code," and just... stopped. Dead. There was no workaround. A fully autonomous agent, defeated by six digits sent to a phone it didn't have.

This isn't an AI that answers your phone. It's a phone number that belongs to your AI.

Every agent framework has gotten very good at giving agents tools. But the moment an agent needs to exist in the physical world - verify an identity, call a human, receive a text - it hits a wall that was built for people:

- No way to provision a number programmatically
- Registration paperwork that takes weeks before the first text sends
- Per-seat pricing that makes no sense when you have 100 agents
- No way for an agent to read an inbound code
- Webhooks you have to host and route yourself

So we built the thing we wanted: one API call, and your agent has a real phone number in about 10 seconds.

What it can do:
- Place and receive voice calls, with real-time transcription, using your own LLM or ours
- Send and receive SMS in 200+ countries
- Message over iMessage from its own number, with automatic RCS/SMS fallback
- Read inbound codes, so phone-gated signups stop being a dead end
- One webhook, one format, every channel

The fastest way to see it: paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Grok Bot, Codex or any agent -

Get yourself a Dial phone number and call me. Say hello and that setup is working, then ask if I have any questions. Follow https://getdial.ai/skills.md

It signs itself up, provisions its own number, and your phone rings. No dashboard, no human in the loop. That's the whole pitch, and you can verify it in about 30 seconds.

We'll be here all day. What's the first thing you'd have your agent call or text? Genuinely curious - the answers to this are how we've picked most of the roadmap so far.

you can also reach us directly at founders@getdial.ai

discord channel - https://discord.com/invite/tEmpesw6GW
This is awesome - now i can ask my claude to book restaurants for me
a real phone number for agents in 10s is wild 😄 mostly inbound or outbound so far?

items.title: Tabbit AI
items.name: Tabbit AI
items.summary: The best AI browser built both for you and your Agents.
items.description: Tabbit is the AI browser that knows what you’re working on and can get the work done for you. Give it the pages, screenshots, and local files that matter, and Tabbit Agent can work across the web now or on a schedule. It delivers usable HTML, PDFs, and presentations, then saves the workflow as a Skill you can run again.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt! 👋

I'm Oliver, from the Tabbit team.

Quick backstory:
I spend most of my day in a browser. Whenever I'm deep in a project, everything I need is scattered across open tabs, local files, and screenshots I don't want to lose.
Then I'd open an AI tool and start copying everything over just so it knew what I was talking about. Once it gave me an answer, the clicking, checking, formatting, and exporting were still on me. There had to be a better way.

What makes Tabbit different:
Tabbit doesn't treat AI as a chat box bolted onto a browser. Point it at the pages, tabs, screenshots, selected text, and local files that matter, then give it a job to do.
Its GUI Agent can operate websites, run a task now or on a schedule, and create an HTML page, a PDF, or a deck you can use right away.

If you find a workflow worth keeping, save it as a Skill. Run it again, tweak it, or share it. We built Tabbit for people who build and research on the web—especially PMs, developers, and technical teams.

What we'd love your feedback on: What's the first tedious browser task you'd happily never do by hand again?

Thanks for taking a look. I'll be here in the comments and would love to hear what you think.
Hi Oliver. You asked what tedious browser task people would happily never do by hand again. What's the answer you've heard most so far, and did it match what you built Tabbit for in the first place?

the "works with your existing login sessions" part is the killer feature and also the scary part at the same time. if the agent runs across the web with my real authenticated sessions, how tightly scoped is it to the pages/domains I actually pointed it at versus being able to wander off into other tabs I'm logged into, like email or banking, while it's doing its own thing

idea_items.title: 法律 AI 工作流
idea_items.need_line: 用户在缺少完整交易背景的情况下，需要快速判断一份合同能否签字以及有哪些关键风险。
idea_items.status_line: 律师强调必须与客户确认交易模式和背景后才能实质审查，而普通用户常直接甩来合同或套用模板，双方在半小时完成“要不要签字”的预期与实际数天工作量之间存在明显落差。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的方向是把交易背景问答与合同条款风险提示结合起来，让 AI 先补齐背景再给出签字建议，而不是只做文本逐条校对。

idea_items.title: 教育 AI 辅导
idea_items.need_line: 教师备课耗时，尤其在凑素材、做课件和设计环节时，缺少能快速把散落资源变成自己上课方案的路径。
idea_items.status_line: 当前讨论多以备课流程梳理加资源站收藏为主，老师靠国家教育资源公共服务平台等网站、套用Focusky和万彩动画大师模板做二次改编来压缩时间。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪方向不是再做一个资源聚合站，而是把名师经验和备课节奏结构化，让AI按个人课堂风格生成待加工的半成品教案。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是求职者真正的痛点不在缺少模拟练习，而在面试后被“等通知”搪塞、无法获得环节级反馈，因此 AI 面试产品应转向对未通过原因的结构化复盘与信号解释。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 候选人最需要知道自己在真实面试中被淘汰的具体环节和说话歧义，避免反复栽在同一处而不自知

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前在知乎靠经验帖猜测“聊得细就是没戏”等信号，在 GitHub 上用自部署模拟面试工具（如 job-hunt-copilot、AI-Interview）准备面题，但都停留在模拟环节，没有解决真实面试后的归因反馈。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是打通模拟面试与真实面试记录，生成落点具体的淘汰原因和风险话术清单（例如个人贡献与团队贡献表述不清晰、过于顺滑的“事后总结”、竞品旁敲侧击式追问等高频信号），而非再做一套题库型面试模拟器。

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，显示B端需求梳理仍是靠个人经验拼出来的耗时活，缺少可复用并被验证的结构化支撑。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: B端产品经理在梳理业务全场景时，最耗神的是要把角色、单据、业务流程、数据传递等要素完整拆出并落到需求文档，手工做慢且担心遗漏

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当下讨论集中在用流程模板和个人方法论来兜底，很多人按标准产品/定制产品分类，再通过梳理组织架构、分角色访谈和整理业务流程来产出需求。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪把角色-单据-流程-数据传递等梳理结构做成的半自动场景建模辅助，让产品经理以结构化输入快速生成全场景需求清单。

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub；合同审查的耗时不止在读条款，更在缺少交易背景，AI 的机会在于把背景询问和风险研判嵌入审查流程，并降低非专业人士自行套用模板的隐患。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户在缺少完整交易背景的情况下，需要快速判断一份合同能否签字以及有哪些关键风险

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 律师强调必须与客户确认交易模式和背景后才能实质审查，而普通用户常直接甩来合同或套用模板，双方在半小时完成“要不要签字”的预期与实际数天工作量之间存在明显落差。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把交易背景问答与合同条款风险提示结合起来，让 AI 先补齐背景再给出签字建议，而不是只做文本逐条校对。
